title: Now we can all generate high-quality 3D on our pcs for free, locally. - I optimized Trellis2 to fit inside 8GB NVIDIA gpus, - works even with 1024^3 voxel detail. It's detail is insane.

replies.body: 6GB might be quite tough to achieve. But you could still generate with the current installer, in 512 voxels I think, which is 130 million cubes, instead of 1024 voxels, which is 1 billion.

comments.author: JoanofArc0531
comments.body: Interesting. How much wear and tear, so to speak, does AI generation do on hardware?

replies.author: ai_happy
replies.body:
well, it's spinning up the GPU to its maximum potential, what it was made for.  
It's giving it a good run, like a heavy blender/3dsmax render would.
